body.x: Celluon(www.celluon.com) presented its laser pico projector "PicoAir" at CES 2015, the world's leading trade show for consumer electronics which took place from Jan. 6 to 9 in Las Vegas.

"PicoAir" can easily be connected to Miracast and DLNA. While the standard Pico projectors use DLP method, PicoAir uses laser method for projection. The advantange of the laser method is that there is no need to set the focus, and the color is more vivid compared to the older models that are based on LED.

This HD-quality, compact-sized projector projects with 720-pixel resolution, and wide projection is possible even when the projection distance is short. It is about the same size and weight as smartphones, and its internal battery lasts full two hours. Since this projector does not have a fan inside, there is no noise when it is turned on, which makes it great for use in small space.
